search.query: | mstats avg("baseline.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("baseline.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("*secure_boot*","*lockdown*","*auditd_active*","*weak_ssh*") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("baseline.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("shadow_min_age","shadow_max_age") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value
